# Block spec — DOCX and PDF

One vocabulary, two renderers. The same spec builds either format; a PDF is
re-typeset rather than converted, so its line and page breaks differ.

```jsonc
{
  "preset": "standard_business_brief",
  "page": { "size": "Letter | A4", "orientation": "portrait | landscape" },
  "meta": { "title": "…", "author": "…", "subject": "…" },
  "header": { "text": "…" },
  "footer": { "text": "…", "pageNumbers": true },
  "toc": true,
  "blocks": [ … ]
}
```

## Presets

| preset | for |
| --- | --- |
| standard_business_brief | read once, on a screen, in a hurry |
| compact_reference_guide | kept open beside the work it describes |
| narrative_proposal | read front to back; serif body, generous leading |
| simple_word_default | what Word gives you when nobody chose anything |
| form_or_questionnaire | printed and filled in; wide leading, room beside every field |

The preset owns every type size, margin, and colour. The spec never sends one.

## Blocks

| type | fields |
| --- | --- |
| title | `text`, `subtitle` — one per document, first |
| heading | `level` 1–3, `text` |
| paragraph | `text` |
| bullets | `items[]` |
| numbered | `items[]` |
| checklist | `items[]` |
| definitions | `items[{term, definition}]` |
| callout | `style` note/warning/decision/summary, `title`, `text` |
| table | `columns[{header, width, align}]`, `rows[][]`, `caption` |
| image | `path`, `width` (percent), `caption`, `alt` |
| chart | `chart {type, categories, series}`, `caption` |
| quote | `text`, `attribution` |
| pageBreak | — |
| signature | `fields[]` |
| formField | `label`, `kind` text/checkbox/choice, `choices[]` |

Callout styles: `note`, `warning`, `decision`, `summary`.
Form field kinds: `text`, `checkbox`, `choice`.

Inline `**bold**`, `*italic*`, and `` `code` `` work in any text field.

## Limits

| what | limit |
| --- | --- |
| blocks in a document | 400 |
| title characters | 200 |
| heading characters | 200 |
| paragraph characters | 8000 |
| list items | 60 |
| characters a list item | 1000 |
| callout characters | 600 |
| table columns | 10 |
| table rows | 200 |
| cell characters | 500 |
| quote characters | 1500 |
| chart series | 6 |
| chart categories | 24 |

Declared column widths must add up to 100%. `toc: true` needs at least one
heading. PDF images must be PNG or JPEG; DOCX also takes GIF.
